markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (94%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class InSitu prediction [F1] with 1% invasive risk, prioritized as a tier-1 surgical frozen section with positive margins.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 94%, Benign 3%, Normal 2%, Invasive 1% | Clear InSitu call; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} (90% target and test coverage) | Single class at dataset-level guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD (12/12 regions) [F6] | Atypical, reliable input; no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree | Independent models match top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (81%–82% similarity) [F5] | Unanimous neighbor support for InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 2, 3) · context · Above-typical score (+1.65, contribution -1.25); descriptive only, 8/20 spot check [F2] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Score +2.10 (+0.64 contribution); unreliable concept with 0/20 spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.36, contribution -0.36) opposes invasion; 12/20 spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Score +0.92 (-0.32 contribution); unreliable concept with 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 6, 8) · ↑ invasive · Score +1.73 (+0.30 contribution); unreliable concept with 3/20 spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion +0.001, 95% CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); mitoses, normal lobules, and necrosis are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Focal stromal invasion in region 8 (22% tile risk) or region 4 (7%) is missed by the slide-level score.
- Simulated composite frozen-section features mimic in situ ductal changes (nearest Normal contrast case is 79% similar) or distort margins.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 4, 5, 9**: Confirm atypical cells remain duct-confined and exclude focal invasion in highest-risk tiles.
2. **Regions 4, 8, 9**: Verify suspected tumor at inferior (323 um) and medial (215 um) margins [F7].
3. **Regions 0, 2, 3, 10, 11**: Inspect lymphocytic infiltrate and background lobules directly, as cell segmentation is disabled.
